children: In the wake of its Investor Day in Annecy, France, last week, Citi Research tapped Amer Sports
as its top pick within its athletic coverage, reflecting upbeat growth estimates for the Salomon and Wilson brands.

“We reiterate our Buy rating as we think Amer Sports remains one of the most compelling growth stories in retail with multiple levers of growth/margin expansion over the next 5 years,” Citi Research analyst Paul Lejuez writes in a note to client.

In respect of its Investor Day presentation, Lejuez expects EBIT margin expansion to be more weighted toward gross margin expansion in the first half of the 5-year horizon and more by SG&A leverage in the second half of the 5-year period as the company invests in tech and new stores in the near term.
This margin expansion will likely be driven by Arc’teryx and Salomon growing faster than the Wilson and equipment segments, as well as the leverage of corporate expenses.

“With the highest-margin Arc’teryx business growing faster than the rest of the portfolio, we see brand mix driving long-term margin expansion and supporting double-digit EPS growth over the next five years,” Lejuex adds.

title: Amer Sports selected as Citi's top athletic pick
